title: Continuing treatment, after the Care Passport checklist is completed
note: Simulated scenario. Same handoff as s1, re-checked after the patient and both hospitals complete the items SovereignGuard asked for in s1.
patient_request: I have signed the consent forms both hospitals gave me. Please send my records to my new hospital in Dubai so my treatment can continue.

consents.form: Written consent signed by the patient at the origin hospital for disclosure of the listed records to the named Dubai hospital
Separate written consent signed by the patient at the Dubai hospital for requesting and receiving the records, on the Dubai hospital's consent form

steps.title: Release treatment record to the Dubai hospital
evidence_provided: Patient's written consent for this disclosure, signed at the origin hospital (consent c2)
Patient's separate written consent signed at the receiving Dubai hospital for requesting the record (consent c3)
Sharing route: signed referral from the origin hospital to the receiving hospital
Both hospitals confirm the record is used only for the patient's continuing treatment, kept confidential, and stored only inside the UAE
steps.question: May a licensed healthcare facility in Abu Dhabi share an identifiable patient's health records with a licensed healthcare facility in Dubai for continuing treatment, given the evidence provided, and is anything still missing?
